newsitem.title: USA: Teletek disovers possible accounting woes.
newsitem.headline: Teletek disovers possible accounting woes.

text.p: Teletek Inc said it has discovered possible irregularities in its accounting and billing procedures.

In November, the U.S. Attorney for the District of Nevada said a federal grand jury charged 19 people, including two past presidents of the company, in connection with alleged securities fraud involving bribes paid in cash and stock to promoters and brokers to sell Teletek shares to the public.
Teletek said Thursday it was conducting an internal audit and probe to discover the extent of any potential problem and, evaluate bonuses to past officers based on improved revenue.
Teletek said it has notified the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and is cooperating with all involved agencies.

It said that upon preliminary investigation, an Independent Advisory Committee discovered several issues which cause the committee concern as to its ability to continue conducting business on an ongoing basis.

These issues include service shut-off from vendors due to excessive account payables and lack of substantial working capital or reliable accounts receivable, potential de-listing on Nasdaq and likelihood of significant litigation costs due to shareholder lawsuits and arbitration.
